contract.cancellation_conditions: Cancel if no value is published for the specified observation period (for example a market or federal holiday), the release is withdrawn, or the measurement cannot be established from an official dated record.
contract.initial_reference_class: Historical daily observations of U.S. 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield
contract.no_condition: The specified published value does not satisfy the yes condition.
contract.normalized_question: Will the first published value of U.S. 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield (not seasonally adjusted, FRED series DGS10) for 2026-10-09 be greater than 5.24 percent in the release expected on 2026-10-12?
contract.original_question: Will the first published value of U.S. 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield (not seasonally adjusted, FRED series DGS10) for 2026-10-09 be greater than 5.24 percent in the release expected on 2026-10-12?
contract.resolution_method: Use FRED series DGS10 (not_seasonally_adjusted, daily, units percent), originally published by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, and the first published value. The initial-release value is the value for 2026-10-09 in the earliest ALFRED vintage of DGS10 that contains that observation. Retain the dated ALFRED vintage CSV and its vintage date as outcome evidence. Do not substitute later revisions for a first release.
suggested_drivers: Scheduled data releases and monetary-policy communications
contract.yes_condition: The first published value of U.S. 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield (not seasonally adjusted, FRED series DGS10) for 2026-10-09 is greater than 5.24 percent.
